proof_body:
by
  intro f a b m M hab hf h
  have hI : IntervalIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume a b := hf.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hab
  have hm : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => m) MeasureTheory.volume a b := intervalIntegrable_const
  have hM : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => M) MeasureTheory.volume a b := intervalIntegrable_const
  constructor
  · have h1 := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hab hm hI (fun x hx => (h x hx).1)
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] at h1
    exact h1
  · have h1 := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hab hI hM (fun x hx => (h x hx).2)
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm (b - a)] at h1
    exact h1
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b m M : ℝ), a ≤ b → ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b) → (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, m ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ M) → m * (b - a) ≤ ∫ x in a..b, f x ∧ (∫ x in a..b, f x) ≤ M * (b - a)
